name: Khel Pratibha Puraskar
benefit: - **Cash Prize:** An amount ranging from ₹10,000/- to ₹5,00,00,000/-.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a sportsperson. - The applicant should have won a medal at a national or international level. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat or should be representing Gujarat officially in the sporting event.
